title: Vertex-cut obstruction for betweenness-uniform blow-ups
source: David Hartman and Aneta Pokorná, “Constructions of betweenness-uniform graphs from trees”, arXiv:2105.06777 (2021; EuroComb 2021), Conjecture 12. https://arxiv.org/abs/2105.06777

significance.root_decision: The conjecture is false. Let G be the wedge of two 5-cycles (order 9, diameter 4, the common vertex a cut vertex). Replace the four neighbours of the cut vertex by K100, the four remaining vertices by K5, and the cut vertex by K604 ⊔ K8 ⊔ K4 ⊔ 25·K1. The resulting 1061-vertex blow-up is connected and every vertex has betweenness exactly 100. The source's obstruction for trees comes from leaves, whose parts carry no global load; in the two-C5 wedge every part lies on a cycle, and a part of the cut vertex that is a disjoint union of cliques adds load only to the neighbouring parts, so its number of non-adjacent pairs is a free parameter that balances the equations. The proof is a general formula for the betweenness of a blow-up whose parts are disjoint unions of cliques, from a lifting lemma for shortest paths; Lean proves the formula in general and evaluates it on the 9-vertex base, never enumerating the 1061 vertices. Lean's betweenness is the source's (unordered pairs), shared verbatim with the accepted 382260 packet.
significance.caveat: Close call on routine (cross-model reviewer and final checker both about 0.60 not routine): disjoint-clique parts are published (Gago, Coroničová Hurajová and Madaras 2013), and what is new is using the non-adjacent pairs of such a part at the cut vertex as a free balancing parameter. The witness has a disconnected part at the cut vertex, which the source allows (it uses edgeless parts itself); the variant with connected parts is open. The construction came from a GPT-6.1 Sol proof lane (3176-vertex family, also formalized), the smaller 1061-vertex witness from the Claude Opus pre-Lean review, and the Lean from a Claude Opus lane; the final check was by a separate Opus lane (same model family as the packager) because GPT-6.1 Sol hit its usage limit.
